_note: Plain-English notes shown in the online app's 'Update ready' card. Newest first. Add an entry with every release.

notes: Updates now wait for you: a blue ! on Settings means a new version is ready, with what's new.
The app checks for new versions whenever you switch back to it.
Done shopping moves ticked items into 'Bought this week', so the list shows only what's left and what it'll cost.
Once tonight's dinner is cooked, the Today card asks how it was.
Calories now show on the Today card, week and recipes. Tap a name for protein and the full breakdown.
Every recipe's method has been rewritten step by step, starting with the chopping and prep.
